description: Shared Renovate preset for every justanotherspy repository. Extend it with `local>justanotherspy/renovate`.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major (minor + patch) updates into a single PR and automerge once CI passes
Automerge digest and pin updates (e.g. SHA-pinned GitHub Actions and Docker image digests)

Major updates get their own PR, are never automerged, and are labelled `major-update` so breaking changes get a human look. Not `major`: release-drafter in garlic, shuck and sproot resolves a `major` label to a major version bump of the repo itself

semgrep pins exact versions of mcp and opentelemetry-api, so a pip-compile file that only asks for semgrep can take a vulnerability fix for either one only by downgrading semgrep (1.185 to 1.79). Leave these two transitive pins alone: they move when a semgrep release moves them, through the normal pip-compile refresh. Remove a name once semgrep no longer pins it
